rationale: Keep Valia Energía as an active North American Actis portfolio company and correct its list-ready profile. The existing headquarters field lists asset geographies rather than the corporate headquarters; Valia's official site identifies its headquarters in Mexico City. Add the official website and verification date, link the 2022 investment milestone to Actis' completion announcement, and make the current Actis portfolio citation the primary ownership source. Actis still marks Valia as current and stated in May 2026 that it had no short-term plans to exit, so preserve the active 2022 Actis Energy 5 ownership period and undisclosed stake.
